function.name: widecast_create_video
function.description: Create a short-form video from either a finished script (source='text', default) or a short idea description (source='idea'). When source='text', provide script_text (80-500 words, used VERBATIM by the narrator). When source='idea', provide idea_text (5-1000 words; longer is auto-truncated server-side, NOT rejected) plus optional language / video_length / research_enabled — the AI writes the narration from the idea then continues into the same scene-sourcing pipeline. Either way returns a video id and initial status='processing'. Call widecast_get_status to poll. When output_type='scene' (default), the pipeline stops at scenes-ready-for-review (result.review_url populated); call widecast_export_video to render the final MP4. When output_type='video', the pipeline auto-chains into the renderer and result.video_url is populated on completion.

source.description: 'text' (default, backward-compat) requires script_text. 'idea' requires idea_text + optional language/video_length/research_enabled.

script_text.description: Required when source='text'. Plain-text narration — used VERBATIM. Must be 80-500 words (~20s to 2 min).

idea_text.description: Required when source='idea'. Short description of what the video should be about. AI writes the narration from this. 5-1000 words; longer is auto-truncated.

video_length.description: Target video length (source='idea' only). 'short' = ~90s; 'normal' = capped at ~3 min.

research_enabled.description: Whether AI does research/fact-check during narration generation (source='idea' only). Default true.

output_type.description: 'scene' stops at scenes-ready-for-review. 'video' auto-chains into the renderer so the final MP4 is produced.

wait_for_render.description: If true, server blocks up to 60s waiting for render. Otherwise async — poll widecast_get_status.

metadata.description: Optional key-value pairs echoed back on get_status. Max 16 keys, 500 chars each.

function.name: widecast_export_video
function.description: Kick the final-MP4 renderer for a video that was created with output_type='scene'. Use this after the scenes are ready for review (status='completed', stage='scenes_ready_for_review') and the user wants to proceed to the final video. Idempotent — calling twice is a no-op. Returns a status snapshot; poll widecast_get_status until result.video_url is populated.

video_id.description: Video id returned by widecast_create_video (e.g. widecast7c0d4f8a9b1e2d3f).

function.name: widecast_get_status
function.description: Poll the current state of a WideCast video by id. Returns status (pending|processing|completed|failed), progress 0..1. When status='completed', result.review_url is the URL where the user reviews scenes + audio, and result.video_url is the direct MP4 URL (populated only for output_type='video' videos or after widecast_export_video succeeds). Recommended polling cadence: 5s initial, ×1.5 exponential backoff, cap at 60s.

video_id.description: Video id returned by widecast_create_video (e.g. widecast7c0d4f8a9b1e2d3f).
